summary_en: Gift Holdings raised its FY2026 October full-year dividend forecast by 1.50 yen to 8.00 yen per share (16.00 yen pre-split equivalent), reflecting better-than-planned nine-month performance. The company maintains its dividend policy prioritizing stable, continuous returns while supporting financial strengthening and business investment.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Increase in Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On September 14, 2026, Gift Holdings revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending October 2026, increasing the year-end dividend per share by 1.50 yen to 8.00 yen (equivalent to 16.00 yen on a pre-split basis). This revision follows the company's August 24 earnings forecast update and reflects better-than-planned performance through the third quarter of the fiscal year.

The company's dividend policy aims to deliver stable and continuous profit returns to shareholders while maintaining financial strength and supporting business expansion through investment. The revised forecast incorporates the favorable nine-month results into the full-year earnings guidance announced on June 15, 2026.

Note that the company is executing a 2-for-1 stock split effective September 1, 2026. The previous forecast announced on July 15, 2026, had projected a year-end dividend of 6.50 yen per share (post-split), which equaled 13.00 yen on a pre-split basis. Prior fiscal year (October 2025) paid annual dividends of 22.00 yen per share on a pre-split basis, equivalent to 11.00 yen post-split.
